# Teyezilla Expeditions

> Teyezilla Expeditions is a premium African travel company offering tailor-made
> safaris, signature journeys, and handpicked experiences across Africa, plus fully
> bespoke private travel for guests who want something built entirely around them.

## How the site is organized
- [Destinations](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations): country-level guides
  (best time to visit, visas, health & packing)
- [Journeys](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/journeys): curated multi-day itineraries,
  from single-country signature trips to multi-country expeditions
- [Experiences](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/experiences): single-day and short
  activities, grouped into six categories: Wildlife & Safari, Beach & Islands, Culture &
  Heritage, Adventure, Food & Lifestyle, and Cities & Local Life
- [Safari](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/safari): the dedicated safari hub:
  safari-specific tours, themes, and a safari guide
- [Collections](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/collections): hand-curated themes that
  group journeys and experiences together (e.g. The Wild, The Ocean, The Heritage, The
  Adventure)
- [Private Travel](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/private-travel) /
  [Tailor-Made Trips](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/tailor-made-trips): fully bespoke
  itineraries built around a guest's own dates, interests, and budget
- [Trip Planner](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/trip-planner): an AI-assisted first
  draft of an itinerary
- [Blog](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/blog): safari guides, destination
  comparisons, and travel tips
- [About](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/about): who Teyezilla Expeditions is,
  founded by Paul Teye
- [FAQs](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/faqs): common questions about booking and
  traveling with Teyezilla Expeditions

## Destinations (open for booking)
[Kenya](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/kenya),
[Tanzania](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/tanzania),
[Zanzibar](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/zanzibar),
[Egypt](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/egypt),
[Morocco](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/morocco),
[Rwanda](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/rwanda),
[Uganda](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/uganda),
[South Africa](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/destinations/south-africa) —
Maasai Mara and Serengeti safaris, Zanzibar beach holidays, the Pyramids and Nile,
Marrakech and the Sahara, gorilla trekking, and Cape Town and the Garden Route.

## Destinations (coming soon)
Namibia, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Seychelles, Mauritius

## Booking
Booking is inquiry-based: visitors send an [enquiry](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/booking)
through the website (or WhatsApp), a travel consultant replies with a personal quote, and
payment is arranged offline (bank transfer, invoice, or in person). No payment is taken
online -- this is permanent, not a launch-phase limitation. See
[Booking Information](https://www.teyezillaexpeditions.com/booking-information) for details.
